column1: # The approved Blacksmith ladder, 2026-09-30. Nate took every default in BLACKSMITH_TIERS_PROPOSAL.md EXCEPT choice 3:
# Dragonscale beats Ebony outright at 44/17/17/22/33, as the interim armorMaterials override counts it today.
# ONE SOURCE, TWO READERS: DBO_BlacksmithTiers.pas (xEdit, on Nat's PC) sets these values; verify_ladder.py checks a
# re-run of material_census.py changed nothing else. Edit this file, never one of the two.
# Only materials whose values CHANGE are listed. A material already at its ladder value is left alone on purpose:
# touching it would flatten third-party sets that deliberately differ, and would fight the chainmail rule below
# (Beyond Skyrim's chainmail carries ArmorMaterialIron / ArmorMaterialSteel, so "all iron = 25" would undo it).
# Saints & Seducers Madness (52 heavy today, above Daedric) follows Daedric - choice 9
# Immersive Armors Daedric variants reach 50 today; follow Daedric - choice 9
# (no IAKMaterialDaedric head rule: Immersive Armors' Daedric set has no head piece carrying that keyword,
#  so a rule for it would match nothing and verify_ladder.py would report it MISSING for ever.)
# CHOICE 3, Nate's pick: Dragonscale beats Ebony (43/16/16/21/32) on every piece
# Saints & Seducers Amber (43 light today, above Dragonscale) follows Glass - choice 9
# Nate, 2026-09-30: "make the imperial shields all 19". 14 shield records carry this keyword, 13 are already 19 and
# exactly one is 25 - ArmorImperialLightShield from DIS_Heavy_Legion.esp - so this rule brings that one down and
# leaves the other 13 untouched. It was the shield the proposal raised as its item 6: at 25 it sat above Elven's 21
# and near Glass's 27. Its origin is third-party, so the override goes into DragonBreak Nexus Patches.
# Beyond Skyrim chainmail has NO material keyword of its own - by editor id instead. See the README.
# Elven down one, Orcish up two, so the Smithing tree's order holds - choice 5
# Stalhrim's war axe and mace come down so Daedric stays strictly above - choice 6
# Saints & Seducers weapons follow their armor's material - choice 9
